messages:
sara: quick question — we're seeing confusing behavior when a single api key hits the edge limit but the org still has burst left. users get a 429 with no hint which quota fired :confused:

alex: yeah this is noisy. edge proxies enforce per-key QPS today, central entitlement enforces org-level monthly/burst. they don't currently annotate responses so caller can't tell.

lina: proposal: proxies should add a small debug header when they throttle: `X-Quota-Source: edge` or `X-Quota-Source: org`, plus `X-Quota-Hint` with slab and remaining-burst if available. that way clients + console can show an explanation.

kevin: fine from network side, but how does proxy learn org burst leftover? we don't want to hit central on every request.

alex: cached tokens at the edge with TTL=30s could carry a lightweight burst counter that's periodically updated by entitlement service. worst-case stale by 30s but good enough for UX and backoff hints.

bryan: console UX side: show two bars on the usage page — "Key-level throttles (QPS)" and "Org burst pool". when a request is 429 we surface the header and a tooltip: "throttled by X (edge/org). retry after Ys or request increased limits."

kevin: implementation detail: entitlement API needs to return a compact `throttle_policy` blob when a key is claimed, e.g. `{"qps":20,"burst_pool":300,"slab":"pro"}`. edge caches that. sync every 30s or on key rotation.

lina: agreed. minimal change: add field `throttle_policy` (stringified JSON) to the /claim-key response. edge will parse it and expose hint headers on 4xx.

sara: sample headers we can standardize on:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 7
X-Quota-Source: edge
X-Quota-Hint: slab=pro;burst-left=45;key-qps=20
```

alex: also add `X-Quota-Grouping: org-id=<id>` for observability so SRE can aggregate throttles by org even when enforced at edge.

bryan: product note — when `burst-left` is low console should show "consider increasing reserved capacity" CTA (links to pricing). keep wording non-alarming.

kevin: one risk — spoofing headers. make sure proxies only emit these and not accept client-sent headers. entitlement service will sign a short HMAC on claim blob so edge can assert authenticity when syncing with cache.

lina: HMAC sounds good. we'll add `claim_sig` returned by entitlement and edge validates on refresh. no extra on-path calls for normal traffic.

ops-bot: deploy plan: dev feature-flag for header emission behind `quota-hint-v1`, rollout to us-west edge first. monitor 429->support tickets delta.

sara: ok action items:
- kevin/lina: spec `throttle_policy` + HMAC in entitlement API (PR by EOD Wed)
- alex: add header emission + cache refresh logic in edge (feature-flag)
- bryan: draft console mockups for dual-bar UX + CTA
- ops-bot: canary plan posted in #eng-infra once PRs land

alex: noted. I'll start a tiny RFC and link it here. short term we can also add logging of which quota fired to help triage.

sara: thanks all. aim to have canary in 2 weeks. :thumbsup:
